info.title: PayPack API
info.description:
HTTP API behind paypack.uno. Every route also answers with a trailing slash (the app uses `trailingSlash: true`).

**Authentication** — `POST /api/auth/login` sets an httpOnly `pp_session` cookie holding a signed JWT; send it with every request. Admin routes additionally require the admin role.

**Errors** — non-2xx responses carry `{ "error": "message" }`. 401 = not signed in, 403 = not allowed (including restricted accounts trying to open deals or move money), 404 = not found or not yours.

**Escrow lifecycle** — pending → escrow (buyer funds, `/accept`) → shipped (seller, `/ship`) → completed (buyer, `/confirm-receipt`); cancel is allowed until shipped; a dispute freezes the deal until an admin decides.

**Checkout widget** — see `/widget.js` and Settings → Checkout Widget in the app.
